title: Top-down 2D arcade racing game with GeneRally physics & Gymnasium API
close_reason: All 5 gauntlet pieces completed, tested, benchmarked, and accepted against Reference Bar C (GeneRally handling + Gymnasium CarRacing-v3).

title: Piece 1: Core Arcade Vehicle Physics & Drift/Slip Dynamics
close_reason: Core 4-wheel arcade physics, Pacejka slip model, weight transfer and determinism implemented and accepted with 3.9M steps/s throughput.

title: Piece 2: Track Boundaries, Surface Geometry & Collision Resolution
close_reason: Track geometry, Catmull-Rom spline, checkpoint sequence enforcement, OBB SAT collisions, and 1.1M rays/s LIDAR implemented and accepted.

title: Piece 3: Headless Engine & Gymnasium Python API Bindings
close_reason: Headless engine & Gymnasium API implemented with 50,339 steps/s vector and 11,062 steps/s RGB software rasterizer. Passed strict check_env and adversarial test suite.

title: Piece 4: Cross-Platform 2D Arcade Renderer & Visuals
close_reason: 2.5D GeneRally arcade renderer, skidmarks/particle FX, dual camera, multi-car bot AI, and real-time telemetry HUD implemented and accepted.

title: Piece 5: Cross-Platform Architecture & Mobile Input Layer
close_reason: Mobile multi-touch input, deterministic .tdr replay engine, ghost vehicle telemetry, and build pipelines for Android, iOS, WASM, and Desktop implemented and accepted.
